analysis:
The only change in this PR is a documentation addition in docs/developer/test.md (head lines 551-561). It adds a swift test invocation for LocalTokenizerByteFallbackTests and a prose description of the test: a synthetic tokenizer with Gemma 4's decoder sequence, loaded through the production LocalTokenizerLoader, must decode `<0xHH>` byte-fallback tokens correctly. The rest of both units (lines 1-463 and 464-918) is unchanged surrounding text that I read for context.

There is no code, configuration, key handling, protocol, or authorization change. The added command is a local synthetic test that uses no credentials, network access, model weights, or production state. This is consistent with the file's existing guidance to keep tests isolated.

The test touches tokenizer decode (byte-fallback handling), which sits near TB-007 (inference engine) and A-001 (prompt/completion content). The PR changes no production decode logic. A fixed real decoder defect would be a separate change, and its source is not in this batch. The doc states the test's scope, so there is no overclaim of attestation, hardware, or serving qualification, and no new attack surface.

No threat-model entries (T-041, TB-011, etc.) are invalidated or need updating. Remaining question for integration: the actual LocalTokenizerByteFallbackTests source and any LocalTokenizerLoader fix are outside this batch, so their correctness is unverified here.
